source: Glasstone & Dolan (1977), Fig. 3.72, peak overpressure from a 1-kiloton free air burst for sea-level ambient conditions (fourmilab's Chapter III, sha-256 d60de70a...)
procedure: the page image (p. 109, 1744 x 2596 px) read where the curve crosses each horizontal grid line (2000 to 0.1 psi), a straight line fitted through the curve's centre on the 11 rows above and below each line; distances by the vertical grid lines (100 to 30 000 ft), log-linear between them. Checked against the book's own example (1 360 ft: 4.2 psi; read directly at that column, 4.37 psi).
uncertainty: about 2 px in the curve, some 1 % in distance
